scripts.dev: concurrently "node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run dev" "node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run cf-typegen
scripts.deploy:frontend: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=clip
scripts.deploy: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run deploy && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=clip
scripts.lint: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run lint && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run lint
scripts.lint:fix: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run lint:fix && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run lint:fix
scripts.format: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run format && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run format
scripts.format:check: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run format:check && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run format:check
